newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Explosion after lovers quarrel in Cambodian capital.
newsitem.headline: Explosion after lovers quarrel in Cambodian capital.

text.p: A grenade exploded overnight in the Cambodian capital close to the scene of a deadly grenade attack almost two weeks earlier, police said.

There were no casualties in the blast which was triggered by a lover's quarrel, said Mak Chito, head of the Phnom Penh municipal police's serious crime department, stressing that it was not politically motivated.
He gave no more details about the explosion which rocked a house some 300 yards from the site of a March 30 grenade attack that left up to 19 people dead and injured more than 100.
Unknown assailants threw four grenades at a crowd of 150-200 people gatherd outside parliament to take part in or watch a demonstration called by the opposition Khmer Nation Party of Sam Rainsy.
Rainsy, the apparent target, narrowly escaped injury.
